_note: Demo meter photos (Creative Commons, found via api.openverse.org on 2026-10-25). Images are NOT in the repo (data/demo_meters is git-ignored); download from `url`. Truth was transcribed by hand from the full-resolution image. expect: read = a clear kWh register is visible, so the reading should be `kwh` (accepted range `accept`); refuse = no single readable kWh register (too far, angled, several meters, wrong screen), so the model should refuse; ambiguous = a number is visible but it is unclear whether it is the full kWh total (either answer is reported, neither is scored).
